defects: LHS index is shifted: uses u '' Iic (n + 1) (n+2 points) instead of gold's u '' Iic n (n+1 points), while the RHS sum remains over Finset.range n (only n terms) instead of range (n+1); this off-by-one is not compensated and makes the equality generally false (e.g., at n=0 it asserts edist (f (u 1)) (f (u 0)) = 0, i.e. f(u 0) = f(u 1), which need not hold).
